Roles and permissions

Donors may submit an offer and view their own receipt link. Staff approve or decline it. Assigned drivers see pickup details only.

Build prompt

Build “In-Kind Donation Intake Portal” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Record item, quantity, condition, pickup window and optional photo. Schedule approved offers, confirm the quantity received and create a single acknowledgment. Donors may submit an offer and view their own receipt link. Staff approve or decline it. Assigned drivers see pickup details only. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

A donor offers 12 coats. Staff approve pickup and record 10 received. The acknowledgment shows 10 coats and a second receipt confirmation cannot create another acknowledgment.
